tool: Any coding agent + an attack-replay harness
toolZh: 任一编码 Agent + 攻击重放装置
title: Security review for AI-written Python
titleZh: AI 写的 Python 代码的安全审查
summary: Review a plausible, AI-style notes service the way an attacker would — close SQL injection, path traversal, a hard-coded secret, fast password hashes, and pickled sessions one class at a time, then prove each fix by replaying the attacks.
summaryZh: 像攻击者一样审查一个看起来没问题、AI 风格的笔记服务——一次一类地堵上 SQL 注入、路径穿越、硬编码密钥、快速密码哈希和 pickle 会话，再通过重放攻击证明每处修复。
outcome: Every one of nine recorded attacks blocked, an attack-replay command that proves it on both scenario skins, and a five-question review habit for the next repository your assistant writes.
outcomeZh: 九个录制攻击全部被挡下、一条能在两个场景皮肤上证明此事的重放命令，以及一套能带去下一个仓库的五问审查习惯。
prerequisites: Python 3.11 or newer available on your PATH
Any coding agent with the FlyPython Skill installed
Comfort running shell commands; standard library only
Can read Python functions with file and SQL operations
prerequisitesZh: PATH 中有 Python 3.11 或更新版本
任一装好 FlyPython Skill 的编码 Agent
能运行 shell 命令；仅用标准库
能读懂带文件与 SQL 操作的 Python 函数

lessons.title: Plausible is not safe
lessons.objective: Read a notes service that looks fine, then replay nine attacks against it and watch every one succeed.
lessons.objectiveZh: 读一个看起来没问题的笔记服务，然后对它重放九个攻击，看着每一个都得手。

lessons.title: Write the threat model as a contract
lessons.objective: For each function, name who controls the input, what they want, and what the code must refuse — then trace every refusal to a test and the Python documentation behind it.
lessons.objectiveZh: 对每个函数，说清谁控制输入、他想要什么、代码必须拒绝什么——再把每一条拒绝追查到一个测试，以及它背后的 Python 文档。

lessons.title: Close one flaw class per turn
lessons.objective: Five bounded turns — search, attachments, secret key, passwords, sessions — each closing one weakness class with a mechanism, never a filter, each proven by tests and the replay.
lessons.objectiveZh: 五个有界轮次——搜索、附件、密钥、密码、会话——每轮用机制（绝不用过滤）堵上一类弱点，并用测试和重放证明。

lessons.title: Review like an attacker
lessons.objective: Replay the second skin, run a static scanner and note what it misses, attack one thing the suite never tried, and write down what is still unreviewed.
lessons.objectiveZh: 重放第二个皮肤、跑一遍静态扫描并记下它漏了什么、攻击一处套件从没试过的地方，并写下还有什么没审查。

lessons.title: Review your own AI-written code
lessons.titleZh: 审查你自己的 AI 代码
lessons.objective: Take the five questions and the scanner pass to a repository you own: find where input crosses a trust boundary, check each crossing for a mechanism, and write down what you did not review.
lessons.objectiveZh: 把五个问题和扫描步骤带到你自己的仓库：找出输入跨越信任边界的地方，检查每处是否用了机制，并写下你没有审查的部分。

scenarios.title: Clinic visit notes
scenarios.blurb: A small clinic's visit notes — every note belongs to one clinician; attachments live under a scans folder. All names and records are fictional.
scenarios.blurbZh: 一家小诊所的就诊记录——每条记录只属于一位医生，附件放在 scans 目录下。所有人名与记录均为虚构。

scenarios.title: Team shared notes
scenarios.blurb: A small team's shared notes app: search, attachments, logins, and sessions.
scenarios.blurbZh: 一个小团队的共享笔记应用：搜索、附件、登录与会话。

verification.method: A 16-test suite plus an attack-replay harness covering nine attacks per skin — SQL injection, path traversal, secret disclosure, weak password hashes, and pickled sessions. The starter lets all nine through; the reviewed solution blocks 9/9 on both skins.
verification.methodZh: 16 个测试的套件，外加每个皮肤重放九个攻击的装置——SQL 注入、路径穿越、密钥泄露、弱密码哈希与 pickle 会话。starter 对九个攻击全部放行；已审核的实现两个皮肤均 9/9 拦截。

level: Reads Python with file and SQL operations comfortably
levelZh: 能顺畅读懂带文件与 SQL 操作的 Python
